name: Szárazd (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szárazd: a red, blue and green shield with a bunch of grapes, an onion and a plough, within a yellow baroque frame, above a scroll inscribed SZÁRAZD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szárazd arms with frame and scroll
